SymbolicEssence.ArchetypalFunction: Divine mother goddess embodying wisdom, maternal protection, interpretation of dreams, and royal lineage
SymbolicEssence.SymbolicCore: The wise mother who interprets destiny and protects her heroic son

Correspondences.Color: Warm Brown, Maternal Gold, Wisdom Blue

DevelopmentalArc: Divine Queen → Mother of Hero → Dream Interpreter → Counselor → Blessing Giver → Mourning Mother

CulturalContext.ReligiousOrRitualUse: Patron of mothers, invoked for dream interpretation, royal legitimation (ancestress), protective prayers, wisdom seeking
CulturalContext.HistoricalEvolution: Ancient mother goddess, mother of legendary kings, remained important in Gilgamesh traditions, represented ideal of wise maternal protection

SymbolicRepresentation.ImageryNotes: Depicted as regal goddess, sometimes with cow imagery, maternal and wise expression, interpreting dreams, blessing her son and his companion
SymbolicRepresentation.PoeticInvocation: I am the wise mother who reads the dreams of destiny, who blesses heroes yet cannot save them, who loves and releases.
SymbolicRepresentation.DreamForm: A wise queen mother interpreting prophetic dreams; blessing a journey you cannot prevent; loving protection that must let go

MetaIntegration.RitualFunction: Invoke for maternal wisdom, dream interpretation, protective blessings, wise counsel, letting go with love
AIPromptSeeds: Generate a wise divine mother who interprets dreams yet cannot prevent destiny, who blesses with full knowledge of coming pain.
Create a queen mother whose wisdom includes knowing when to hold and when to release.
NarrativeHooks: Blessing the friend as another son
